note: top-left origin, px. screen = active display opening (holdout) in front_body.png; its corners are superellipse (squircle) curves. radius_cover = CSS border-radius to give the screen content placed UNDER front_body (largest circular radius that still covers the whole hole: the content corners that poke out are hidden by the opaque bezel). radius = circle-equivalent radius (same 45-degree point; leaves up to radius_eq_max_gap px uncovered near the tangents). Stack (bottom->top): front_shadow, screen content, front_body, front_glass (normal blend) or front_glass_screen (mix-blend-mode: screen).
